description: This file defines the ManyToOneRelationship class in a SuiteCRM module, managing metadata for many-to-one relationships by extending an abstract relationship class and utilizing a one-to-many relationship object internally. It includes methods for building labels, subpanel definitions, vardefs, layout fields, and metadata, as well as setting and deleting relationships.

classes.name: ManyToOneRelationship
classes.description: A class managing metadata for a many-to-one relationship, reversing roles of modules and keys, built upon an abstract relationship framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object by merging provided definitions with defaults and creating an internal OneToManyRelationship object with reversed labels, modules, and keys.

methods.name: buildLabels
methods.description: Delegates label building to the internal OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Delegates subpanel definition construction to the internal OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Delegates vardef construction to the internal OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Returns layout fields specific to the left-hand module unless relationship is marked as 'only', in which case returns an empty array.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Delegates relationship metadata construction to the internal OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the relationship name in both the parent class and the internal OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Marks the relationship as read-only in parent and internal objects.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the relationship, invoking delete routines in parent and internal objects.

methods.name: setRelationship_only
methods.description: Marks the relationship as relationship-only in parent and internal objects.
